GLOBAL SPECIFICATION — STYLE: 3D DIORAMA TAROT STOP-MOTION AND PHOTOGRAPHIC EVOLUTION

Miniature 3D tactile stage based on the Rider-Waite-Smith Tarot. Handmade figures and environments in 3D resin, clay, and heavy paper inside a mini theatrical stage. Studio lighting with dramatic rim light, volumetric shadows, rich and saturated color palette, and a subtle tilt-shift depth of field effect.

PHOTOGRAPHIC AND CARD EVOLUTION EFFECT:
The Rider-Waite-Smith tarot illustrations and historical photos start in high-contrast black and white, instantly shift to warm vintage Kodachrome/lithographic color tones, and finally transform into a hyper-realistic, volumetric 3D render inside the diorama.

TIPOGRAFÍA Y SÍMBOLOS EN ESPAÑOL:
Large 3D kinetic typography in Spanish with mystical editorial-style serif letters, featuring a solid matte texture or gold leaf finish, casting soft shadows on the diorama background. The text snaps into place with a stop-motion animation rhythm.
